conditions.evidence: Monitoring of pain and nociception in critical care patients
conditions.label: pain / nociception

output.population: Human; mechanically-ventilated intesive care patients unable to self-report pain; 180 participants
output.summary: Frontal EEG and nociception monitor recordings from mechanically ventilated intensive care patients unable to self-report pain, captured during putatively noxious and non-noxious interventions such as endotracheal suction and positioning.
